get.description: data.valid and data.cgus [{title, HTML description}]. Read-only.

post.summary: Check out the cart: CREATES THE ORDER
post.description: Checked on 2026-11-08 with an authorised Public Cloud order: creates the order immediately, WHATEVER THE BODY (no terms-acceptance field required) → {data: {order_id}}. The cart goes to status awaiting_payment. Payment (pre-authorisation, card) then happens in the shop.infomaniak.com session (payment/* routes, not available with a token); until it is done, the product is not created. An MCP client MUST ask for explicit confirmation before this call and show the terms (GET .../checkout → cgus).

post.summary: Add a product to the cart
post.description: Adds an item in draft status. Public Cloud: body {} then PUT the item with customer_name; total 0 (pay as you go), pre-authorisation 20. item parameter: product type (public_cloud, ksuite, email_hosting, drive, item_option, domains_options_prices…) for GET/POST, item id (setup.id) for PUT/DELETE.

put.description: Body = attributes (e.g. {customer_name}). The item goes to status valid once validation.errors is empty. item parameter: product type (public_cloud, ksuite, email_hosting, drive, item_option, domains_options_prices…) for GET/POST, item id (setup.id) for PUT/DELETE.
